mapper.select: SELECT id,username,role,status,created_at FROM app_user WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE app_user SET username=#{username},password_hash=#{passwordHash},role='ADMIN',status='ACTIVE' WHERE id=1 AND status='PENDING' AND password_hash IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.user_id,s.csrf_hash,s.expires_at,u.username,u.role,u.status FROM auth_session s JOIN app_user u ON u.id=s.user_id WHERE s.token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND s.expires_at>#{now} AND u.status='ACTIVE'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM auth_session WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM auth_session WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{maximum}) retained)
mapper.select: SELECT id,username,role,status FROM app_user WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM auth_event WHERE account_hash=#{key} AND success=0 AND created_at>=#{since}
